Realty Income (O) Holder Zevin Asset Management Upped Stake by $303,960; As Oracle (ORCL) Stock Price Declined, Narwhal Capital Management Has Increased Holding
June 21, 2018 - By Maria Brooks
Narwhal Capital Management increased its stake in Oracle Corp (ORCL) by 12.08% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Narwhal Capital Management bought 10,733 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.15% with the market. The hedge fund held 99,583 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $4.56 million, up from 88,850 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Narwhal Capital Management who had been investing in Oracle Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $176.85B market cap company. The stock increased 1.17% or $0.5 during the last trading session, reaching $43.32. About 8.39M shares traded. Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) has risen 3.98% since June 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 8.59% the S&P500.
